r.d: Provide an interface to the OpenStreetMap services.
r.n: * Minimum version of PHP raised to PHP 7.1 * Should be compatible with PHP 7.2 * Retrieval of notes via search endpoint added (thanks to LiamBailey) * Some key/value checks for max length 255 (thanks to LiamBailey) * Documentation broken out to separate files (thanks to franciscollanquipichun) * SSL Options can be configured (Issue #32) * Support for Wildcard Search has been added (Issue #22) * Support for OAuth has been added (thanks to khvalov) * Support for variable times around sunset/sunrise has been added.
